title: Decision
description:
Guiding question: Why was this approach chosen?

A decision records a deliberate architectural choice, the circumstances that motivated it, and the reasoning behind it. Decisions are immutable once recorded. A subsequent decision may supersede an earlier one without modifying the original.

id.description: Permanent, unique identifier. IDs must never be reused.

name.description: Short, descriptive name of the decision.

context.description: Describes the problem, circumstances, or constraints that motivated the decision.

decision.description: States what was decided, using clear and unambiguous language.

rationale.description: Explains why this approach was chosen, including relevant trade-offs or rejected alternatives.

supersedes.description: Earlier decisions replaced by this decision. The referenced decisions remain unchanged.
